headline: SFG @ MIA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 4.22 at MIA 4.34, with a projected total of 8.55. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (SFG +0.13, MIA +0.14), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.32, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +14.0%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Max Meyer has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Liam Hicks, Otto Lopez, Luis Arraez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Willy Adames because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
